entries.desc: sessionId 稳定生成（同一 session 内一致）；第一条 story-scoped mutating 命令为 story 写出 owner-lease.json，含 sessionId/hostname/pid/cwd/command/acquiredAt/heartbeatAt

evidence.note: amendment wiring check — first mutating command acquires owner lease; verify sessionSource recorded

entries.desc: owner 后续 story-scoped mutating 命令刷新 owner-lease.json 的 heartbeatAt

evidence.note: amendment wiring check 2 — second mutating command from a fresh shell must refresh, not self-reject as foreign

entries.desc: story 到 DONE/DISCARDED 且 cleanup 成功后 owner lease 释放

evidence.note: smoke section 4 asserts releaseOwnerLease removes owner-lease.json (the terminal-state DONE/DISCARDED cleanup release path) and is idempotent — releasing an absent lease is a no-op false

entries.desc: owner-lease.json 是进程元数据——在 session_brief 可见、但不计入 verification evidence

evidence.note: owner-lease.json is process metadata only: the CHK-001 lease module (story-owner-lease.ts) writes nothing into the verificationEvidence pipeline and is registered in runtime-artifact-registry as materialHash:exclude — it is excluded from material hashing and never enters gate evidence; smoke section 7 asserts the material-excluded classification. session_brief rendering of the lease is CHK-004 scope

entries.desc: owner-lease.json 不在 DONE 前留未提交脏写（防 F-008 同类 partial-DONE）

evidence.note: smoke section 7 asserts the F-008-class dirty-write prevention: owner-lease.json is a registered runtime artifact (runtime-story-owner-lease entry — volatile + materialHash:exclude) and the runtime ignore patterns include the glob-star owner-lease.json pattern; .gitignore also carries it, so the lease is never tracked and never produces an uncommitted dirty write that could block the DONE git merge

entries.desc: 每个已注册 command 在 CommandPolicy 都有 ownershipClass（readOnly/storyScopedMutating/reviewerWrite/mainSharedMutating/dangerousMutating）——contract test 枚举真实 registry 断言全覆盖、缺一即 fail

evidence.note: command-ownership-contract case 1 (COVERAGE) enumerates the real MAIN_TOOLS registry (94 commands) and asserts every CLI command has a CommandPolicy entry with a valid OwnershipClass enum value — a missing entry or invalid ownershipClass fails the contract.

entries.desc: 非 owner session 跑 story-scoped mutating 命令（如 checklist_update）被 fail-closed 拒绝，附 owner guidance

evidence.note: command-ownership-contract case 5a drives enforceStoryOwnerLeaseGate: a storyScopedMutating command (checklist_update) from a non-owner session on a foreign-owned story is rejected fail-closed (assert.throws) with owner guidance.

entries.desc: read-only 命令在任何 session 永不被 owner lease 拦

evidence.note: command-ownership-contract case 5b asserts the four read-only commands (story_get/checklist_get/finding_list/session_brief) pass enforceStoryOwnerLeaseGate on a foreign-owned story (assert.doesNotThrow) — readOnly is never lease-blocked.

entries.desc: finding_resolve/finding_dismiss owner-gated；但 B-META finding 的 resolve/dismiss 归 mainSharedMutating、走 B-f60c main write lock 不走 owner lease

evidence.note: command-ownership-contract case 4 rule 1: resolveEffectiveOwnershipClass classifies finding_resolve/finding_dismiss on a normal story as storyScopedMutating (owner-gated) and on a B-META-* story downgrades to mainSharedMutating (serialized by the B-f60c main write lock, not the owner lease).

entries.desc: validate --story=B-xxx owner-gated；不带 --story 的纯诊断型 validate 不要求 story owner lease

evidence.note: command-ownership-contract case 4 rule 2 + cases 5d/5e: validate with --story resolves to storyScopedMutating and is rejected fail-closed for a non-owner (5d); diagnostic validate without --story resolves to readOnly and is allowed (5e).

entries.desc: reviewer-write 豁免窄：main agent 不能借 delivery_check_set 绕过 owner lease——delivery_check_set 仅在 actor/lane=delivery reviewer 时算 reviewerWrite，否则按 storyScopedMutating 或拒绝

evidence.note: command-ownership-contract case 4 rule 3: delivery_check_set is reviewerWrite only when agentId/KOALA_AGENT resolves to koala-review-delivery; for a main/non-delivery actor it stays owner-gated storyScopedMutating — a main agent cannot borrow delivery_check_set to bypass the owner lease.

entries.desc: 未分类（缺 ownershipClass）的命令 gate fail-closed，不默认放行

evidence.note: command-ownership-contract case 3 + case 5f: an unclassified command resolves to null (resolveEffectiveOwnershipClass) and enforceStoryOwnerLeaseGate rejects it fail-closed ('no valid ownershipClass'), never default-allowing.

entries.desc: owner lease heartbeatAt 超过 30 分钟无刷新 → 判 stale

evidence.note: smoke section 8 exercises isLeaseStale against the 30-minute STALE_LEASE_THRESHOLD_MS: a heartbeatAt older than 30min is stale, newer is active, with exact-boundary, null-lease and unparseable-heartbeat cases.

entries.desc: --takeover 把 stale lease 转移给当前 session 并记录一条 takeover event

evidence.note: smoke section 9: --takeover transfers a STALE foreign lease to the current session via takeOverOwnerLease and appends a story-owner-lease-takeover event to .koala/activity.jsonl (the test filters the activity log for that event).

entries.desc: 非 stale（活跃）lease 不能被 --takeover，需显式 --forceTakeover（视为人工批准）

evidence.note: smoke section 10 asserts --takeover on an ACTIVE (non-stale) lease is refused (reason lease-active, lease unchanged); section 11 asserts --forceTakeover transfers the active lease and logs a forceTakeover event.

entries.desc: 无 --takeover/--forceTakeover 时不转移任何 lease；takeover 走 dangerous-mutating 纪律、记录 event

evidence.note: smoke section 12: with no --takeover/--forceTakeover flag a foreign lease is not transferred (acquireOrRefreshOwnerLease returns foreign, zero writes — the CHK-002 fail-closed reject holds); also covers takeover guards for no-lease / already-owned / invalid kind.

entries.desc: 非 owner mutation 错误消息含：哪个 story 被 own、owner sessionId/cwd/last-heartbeat、是否 stale、允许的下一步动作

evidence.note: smoke section 13 asserts formatNonOwnerError carries the full Error UX field set: owned storyId / owner sessionId / owner cwd / heartbeat age (<n>m ago) / stale verdict / rejected command + ownershipClass / current session id / allowed next action — with the stale variant pointing at --takeover and the active variant at read-only+--forceTakeover; cli-engine.ts non-owner rejection calls this single formatter

entries.desc: session_brief 渲染 owner session / owner cwd / heartbeat age / stale|active / 当前 session 是否 owner / 推荐动作（proceed|read-only|takeover available|wait）

evidence.note: smoke sections 14+15 assert the session_brief ownership rendering: summarizeOwnerLease produces the structured view (owner session+source / owner cwd / heartbeat age / stale|active / isCurrentSessionOwner / recommendation), and renderOwnershipBlock emits the ## Story ownership lines covering owner session/cwd/heartbeat/OWNER-or-NOT/recommended action for owned-active, foreign-stale (takeover available) and foreign-active (read-only only) cases

entries.desc: B-META 在 session_brief 单独显示 shared audit state，且不建议 story_advance

evidence.note: smoke section 16 asserts renderMetaAuditBlock renders a B-META container as a separate ## Shared audit state (B-META) block — stating it carries no per-story owner lease (writes serialized by the main write lock) and explicitly telling the agent not to story_advance it (story_advance appears exactly once, only in the Do-not prohibition); session.ts session_brief active-story branch routes isMetaContainer storyIds to this block instead of the owner-lease block

entries.desc: owner lease 不阻断 reviewer read-only flow——story_get/checklist_get/finding_list/session_brief 在非 owner session 仍放行

evidence.note: command-ownership-contract case 5b asserts the owner lease never blocks the reviewer read-only flow: with a foreign session owning the story, enforceStoryOwnerLeaseGate does NOT throw for story_get / checklist_get / finding_list / session_brief (all classified readOnly so the gate returns early); story-owner-lease-smoke section 17 additionally asserts a non-owner reviewer session can readOwnerLease / summarizeOwnerLease a foreign-owned story with NO lease write

entries.desc: koala doctor 检出并报告 stale story owner lease

evidence.note: smoke section 18: the doctor stale-lease scanner (scanStoryOwnerLeases / renderStoryOwnerLeaseScan in core/story-owner-lease-doctor.ts, wired into koala doctor) detects and reports a stale owner lease with a STALE line; active and absent leases are not false-positived.

entries.desc: smoke：两 session 对同一 story 跑 mutating → 第二个被拒并附 owner guidance；两 session 对不同 story → 都正常推进

evidence.note: smoke section 19: two sessions mutating the SAME story -> the second is fail-closed rejected with owner guidance via enforceStoryOwnerLeaseGate; section 20: two sessions on DIFFERENT stories -> both proceed (per-story leases never cross-contend).

entries.desc: smoke：stale-lease takeover 仅在显式 --takeover + event 记录下允许；active-lease takeover 被拒（除非 --forceTakeover）

evidence.note: smoke section 21: stale-lease takeover is rejected without a flag and allowed only with --takeover + a logged takeover event; section 22: active-lease takeover is rejected with plain --takeover and allowed only with --forceTakeover + event.

entries.desc: smoke：非 owner session 下 reviewer read-only flow 与 reviewer-write（合法 reviewer run 下）仍成功

evidence.note: smoke section 24: on a foreign-owned story a non-owner session's reviewer read-only commands and a reviewerWrite command (review_pass_set) both pass the gate — the owner lease does not block reviewer read-only flow or the lane-scoped reviewer-write exception.

entries.desc: smoke：owner-lease.json 在 DONE 前后无未提交脏写（F-008 同类回归断言）

evidence.note: smoke section 25 (F-008-class regression): git check-ignore confirms **/owner-lease.json is ignored, and after acquiring a real lease into .koala/story/actives/B-c55d/ the file does NOT appear in git status --porcelain — the lease never produces an uncommitted dirty write that could block a DONE merge.

entries.desc: koala validate 全绿（含新增 story-owner-lease smoke 与 command-ownership contract）

evidence.note: koala validate --story=B-c55d runs the full suite: the story-owner-lease-smoke (cases 1-25) and command-ownership-contract (94 commands) tasks both report ALL PASS alongside the lint and process-fact-contract gates — validation commands pass.
